## UI-11: Community & Contribution

**Figma frame:** _Community & Contribution_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design
**Complexity:** Medium (150 points)
**Estimated time:** 2 to 3 days

> 🎨 **Design-only issue** — you work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (styles), UI-18 (Button), UI-19 (Card), UI-20 (grid).

---

### Context

This section invites people to join and contribute — links to GitHub, the issue
tracker / good-first-issues, discussions/Discord, and the Drips/funding angle.
It's the "get involved" moment near the bottom of the page.

---

### Why this matters

`use-stellar` grows through contributors (these very issues). A warm, clear
"here's how to help" section with obvious CTAs converts interested visitors into
contributors and funders.

---

### What to design (in Figma)

- Section heading + supporting copy per the frame.
- Contribution/community entry points as **Card**s (UI-19) or a CTA cluster:
  e.g. "Star on GitHub", "Good first issues", "Join the discussion", "Fund on
  Drips" — with UI-18 `Button` instances.
- Any stats/social proof (stars, contributors) if the frame shows them.

---

### Deliverables

- Desktop + mobile versions.

---

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Heading, copy, and all community CTAs present per the frame
- [ ] CTAs use UI-18 `Button`; cards use UI-19 `Card`
- [ ] Aligned to UI-20 grid; styles from UI-17 — no loose hex
- [ ] Mobile version designed
- [ ] Frame shared for review; `Closes #[issue number]`
- [ ] **Your PR targets the `dev` branch** — work pushed to `main` (or any
      branch other than `dev`) will **not** be merged
- [ ] ⭐ Leave a star on the project — it is small, free, and very much
      appreciated
- [ ] Open your PR **before the wave ends** — anyone without a submitted PR by
      then is automatically unassigned so the task can go to someone else
